Package com.sca4d.auth.email.challenge

Class EmailCodeChallengeService

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.auth.email.challenge.EmailCodeChallengeService
public class EmailCodeChallengeService extends Object
签发匿名一致的 Challenge，异步登记通知，并原子验证 Argon2id 验证码摘要。
